messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple containers restarting on gpu-cluster-a due to CUDA OOM during prefill for requests with long context (>64k tokens). 6 restarts in 3m. Pods: inference-v2-[1..6].

incident-bot: severity=high, symptom=container_restart, probable_cause=prefill_gpu_oom, affected_zone=us-west-2, runbook=priv/prefill-oom-runbook v2

sophia (oncall): ack. i'm paged and on it. pushing to ops bridge.

sophia (oncall): quick ask — are we seeing a single noisy model or across multiple model variants?

maarten: logs show repeated cuda error: "CUDA out of memory" during kv-cache prefill. appears concentrated on gptx-13b-ctx65 topologies. sample stack: ```E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:xx] failed to allocate 5.4G (out of memory)
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

amelia: confirmed. kvcache growth for long-window requests isn't trimming. high token-count + continuous batching caused mem spike.

sophia (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) set feature flag prefill-trim=true for service route, 2) reduce continuous_batch_max_tokens to 8k, 3) fallback long-context requests to coldmodel-small. can someone run the flags?

kevin (support): i've opened a short feature-flag toggle: `ff toggle prefill-trim --env=prod --service=inference` — rolling to 3 nodes now.

maarten: i can scale down continuous_batch_max_tokens via kustomize patch: `kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
...
EOF` will push in ~30s. also enabling per-request token cap at the gateway: `X-Max-Tokens: 65000` -> 32k for now.

sophia (oncall): do that. also enable hotpool eviction for kv-cache: `/ops/hotpool evict --age>10m --prefix=kv*`

amelia: eviction issued. hotpool evict returned 120 entries removed from gpu caches. memory usage on nodes dropping.

support-bot: note: customer-facing ticket created: INC-8673. affected customers identified: beta-retail, docuflow-pro, and two internal test tenants. severity: degraded streaming and occasional errors.

sophia (oncall): customer-impact update to page: degraded streaming for heavy-long-context calls, retries are succeeding with trimmed prefill but some clients see increased latency. sending note to support to update customers.

maarten: rolling restart of problematic pods scheduled: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-v2 --namespace=prod --selector=zone=us-west-2` — doing in waves to avoid cluster-wide disruption.

kevin (support): support has sent a templated note: "We're seeing high-memory prefill on long-context requests leading to restarts. Mitigations in progress (prefill trimming + throttling). Workaround: shorten prompt or set streaming=false. We'll post updates every 30m."

raj (next-oncall): i'm shadowing and will take over for the 20:00 UTC handoff. please leave the mitigation checklist in the thread.

sophia (oncall): handing off in 25m. checklist: 1) confirm prefill-trim FF remains on, 2) confirm continuous_batch_max_tokens=8k, 3) confirm hotpool eviction completed and cache stable, 4) watch restarts <1/hr per node, 5) escalation to infra-eng if restarts resume.

amelia: note: we saw one noisy tenant throttling rule misapplied causing repeated large-context jobs to be routed to same node — fixed route policy now uses round-robin across hotpool.

maarten: after mitigations, GPU memory usage dropped ~40% on affected nodes, restarts stopped. i'll keep increased logging for next 2h and enable a regression alert `prefill.oom.repeat > 2 in 30m` to page infra.

sophia (oncall): thanks. i've updated the incident ticket with timeline and customer impact. handing pager to raj at 20:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
